brief:
Settlers attacked a vehicle traveling between the villages of al-Mugheir and Abu Flah northeast of Ramallah, the Ma'an news agency reported. The assault occurred on the road connecting the two communities in the northern West Bank region.

The attack resulted in the vehicle overturning. Details regarding the number of occupants, their condition, or the extent of damage to the vehicle were not immediately available. The incident marked another instance of settler violence in the area, where such attacks on Palestinian motorists have been a recurring concern.
title: Settlers attack vehicle on road north of Ramallah, causing it to flip.
